name: Corrupted Whipper Root
objectiveText: Progress You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a whipper root plant.  The visible roots of the plant appear tough and leathery, and a slimy film hangs from the plant.  It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal. Cenarion Plant Salve  ( 3 )

comments.body: Using a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=11516/cenarion-plant-salve]salve[/url] on this will spawn a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=164883/cleansed-whipper-root]cleansed version[/url] that, when opened provides [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=11951/whipper-root-tuber]this[/url]
gives a carrot that heals you for 800 odd damage, its on a seperate CD to a healing potion, so can be used with the pot at the same time
replies: The cool down is also shared with health stones, so using this over a health stone is not advisable but if you font have any health stones it's all gravy ;D
